<header class="ws-head"><span class="ws-kicker">Day 1 · Module 3 · fills Sheet 3</span><h2>Standards, specifications and the core data set</h2><p class="ws-carries">Which standards do we adopt rather than author — and who owns the national core data set?</p></header>
<h3>On the canvas</h3><section class="ws-canvas"><img src="country-canvas/page-4.png" alt="Country Canvas Sheet 3: Core data set, terminology and specifications"/><div><h3>Sheet 3 · Core data set, terminology and specifications</h3><ol class="ws-parts"><li><span class="ws-min">20 min</span><b>Data elements</b>15 immunization DAK elements, each captured Same, Differently or Not at all.</li><li><span class="ws-min">5 min</span><b>Our terminology and specifications</b>SNOMED CT, ICD, LOINC, the terminology service, the core data set, the national FHIR IG, the IPS and the SMART immunization DAK.</li><li><span class="ws-min">5 min</span><b>Who owns it, and what we buy</b>Who would own the core data set and run the terminology service; what goes into the next procurement.</li></ol><p class="ws-links"><a href="country-canvas.html">The whole canvas</a><a href="country-canvas-a3.docx">Word file (A3)</a><a href="country-canvas-a3.pdf">PDF</a></p></div></section>
<h3>Where it meets the journey</h3><div class="ws-cards"><div class="ws-card"><a class="ws-step" href="en/smart-trust-demo/journeys/smart-trust-demo/workshops/dpi-h-policy-track/walkthrough/J2a/">J2a</a><b>A health worker finds the baby — and reads his cards</b><p><span class="ws-t">What the system does</span>A core data element that tells a reported dose from a verified one.</p><p><span class="ws-p">Policy question</span>Who in your country defines the data element that tells a reported dose from a verified one?</p></div><div class="ws-card"><a class="ws-step" href="en/smart-trust-demo/journeys/smart-trust-demo/workshops/dpi-h-policy-track/walkthrough/J3b/">J3b</a><b>Taifafeki vaccines are fitted to the Onesan schedule</b><p><span class="ws-t">What the system does</span>Terminology service: Taifafeki's product code kept, Onesa's schedule code added beside it; schedule logic over every dose.</p><p><span class="ws-p">Policy question</span>Who owns your national core data set and the code maps to other countries, and is vaccine code licensing settled?</p></div></div>
<p class="ws-also">Also draws on <span title="Will you adopt the immunization core data set, or design your own national form?"><a class="ws-step draws" href="en/smart-trust-demo/journeys/smart-trust-demo/workshops/dpi-h-policy-track/walkthrough/J1/">J1</a></span><span title="Will you adopt the IPS and the VHL specification as they are, and author only national extensions?"><a class="ws-step draws" href="en/smart-trust-demo/journeys/smart-trust-demo/workshops/dpi-h-policy-track/walkthrough/J4.0b/">J4.0b</a></span></p>
<h3>Questions for the table</h3><ul class="ws-qs"><li><a class="ws-step" href="en/smart-trust-demo/journeys/smart-trust-demo/workshops/dpi-h-policy-track/walkthrough/J2a/">J2a</a><span>Does your national core data set tell a dose the family reported from one that was verified? Who defines that element?</span></li><li><a class="ws-step" href="en/smart-trust-demo/journeys/smart-trust-demo/workshops/dpi-h-policy-track/walkthrough/J3b/">J3b</a><span>Who owns the national core data set and the mapping between other countries’ vaccine codes and yours?</span></li><li><a class="ws-step" href="en/smart-trust-demo/journeys/smart-trust-demo/workshops/dpi-h-policy-track/walkthrough/J3b/">J3b</a><span>Which code systems do you use for vaccine products, and is the licence question settled?</span></li></ul>
<h3>Terms you will hear</h3><div class="ws-terms"><a href="glossary.html#term-point-of-service-application" title="Point-of-service applications are end-user application components (IT systems or software tools) used by individuals directly engaged in healthcare—such as clinicians, community health workers, and patients—that enable interaction with the broader healthcare ecosystem.">Point-of-Service Applications</a><a href="glossary.html#term-verifiable-credential" title="A digitally signed statement, such as a vaccination record, that anyone can check is genuine and unaltered.">Verifiable credential</a><a href="glossary.html#term-digital-signature" title="A cryptographic seal made with the issuer's private key. Verifiers check it with the matching public key.">Digital signature</a><a href="glossary.html#term-core-data-set" title="The elements a country agrees to record for a use case, each mapped to standard codes. Also called a minimum data set.">Core data set</a><a href="glossary.html#term-terminology-service" title="The Terminology Service is a governed, publicly accessible service that manages, publishes, and provides access to the standardised terminologies, code systems, value sets, and concept maps used across the digital health ecosystem.">Terminology Service</a><a href="glossary.html#term-logical-information-model" title="The agreed structure of the data: elements, types and rules, independent of any software.">Logical information model</a><a href="glossary.html#term-snomed-ct" title="Systematized Nomenclature of Medicine Clinical Terms is a structured clinical terminology standard for use in electronic health records.">SNOMED CT</a><a href="glossary.html#term-decision-support-engine" title="The Computable Decision Support Engine is a governed, shared application component that delivers context-appropriate, evidence-based guidance at the point of clinical decision-making by applying computable clinical rules and knowledge artefacts to person-specific health data.">Computable Decision Support Engine</a><a href="glossary.html#term-smart-guidelines" title="Standards-based, Machine-readable, Adaptive, Requirements-based, Testable Guidelines are a comprehensive set of reusable digital health components (e.g., interoperability standards, code libraries, algorithms, technical and operational specifications) that transform the guideline adaptation and implementation process to preserve fidelity and accelerate uptake. SMART Guidelines provide a five-step pathway to advance the adoption of best clinical and data practices, even if a country is not yet fully digital.">SMART Guidelines</a><a href="glossary.html#term-digital-adaptation-kit" title="Software-neutral L2 content: personas, workflows, core data dictionary, decision logic, indicators and requirements.">Digital adaptation kit</a><a href="glossary.html#term-dose-number-and-series" title="Which dose this is, out of how many in the schedule. Needed to work out what is due next.">Dose number and series</a><a href="glossary.html#term-expanded-programme-on-immunization" title="The national immunization programme.">Expanded Programme on Immunization</a></div>
